answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20585 Country: India Title: I have started offering Salah at the age of 20 and i don't remember the age of my puberty. Now i want to perform my Qaza Salah. How many years Qaza i have to do and how shall i do? I mean which years Qaza i will first do and is it ok to make 5 Qaza prayers everyday after each Salah? Question: Assalamu alaikum. Dear Mufti Sahab, I have started offering Salah at the age of 20 and i don't remember the age of my puberty. Now i want to perform my Qaza Salah. How many years Qaza i have to do and how shall i do? I mean which years Qaza i will first do and is it ok to make 5 Qaza prayers everyday after each Salah? Jazakkallah Khair. Answer ID: 20585 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 404/324/B=1431) Usually, a child attains puberty at the age of fifteen, however if he had experienced wet dreams before fifteen years in this case he would be considered matured from this time, and would be responsible to carry out all the Islamic commandments. If you were lazy in performing salah before you reached twenty, in this case you will have to perform the missed salah of five years. You can perform five missed salah after each salah. Keep on performing according to your ease. Your religious concerns are praiseworthy, may Almighty Allah make you pious and grant you steadfastness . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
